Duffy Boat Rental
services.desc: Capital Cruises is proud to offer “Donut Boat” rentals exclusively to Lady Bird Lake, providing the latest small group electric boat adventure for the ultimate Austin experience. The Donut Boat’s unique design allows up to 10 people to casually cruise around Lady Bird Like, gathered around a center table, shaded by a center-post umbrella. The quiet electric motor allows you to easily chat with your friends and drives with the ease of a golf cart on the water. Never driven a boat? No problem, as you’ll receive an orientation. Feel free to bring your own food and snacks (small- to medium-sized coolers work best), or choose from one of our plated options from the Hyatt Regency Austin. It’s fun

includes: All safety equipment provided for kayak tours
blurb: Capital Cruises offers electric boat rentals, guided kayak tours, and public or private cruises on Lady Bird Lake. Guests can enjoy bat-watching tours, dinner cruises, and customized events such as weddings and corporate outings. The fleet includes paddle boats, donut boats, Duffy boats, and stand-up paddleboards.
